results.original_text: As a site editor, I want to have pretty good control over how the article, so that articles are visually appealing.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over the formatting and layout of articles, so that I can ensure each article is visually engaging and aligns with brand standards.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The editing interface must allow adjustments to at least 10 formatting elements, including fonts, colors, headings, images, and spacing.
- Article previews should update in real-time, reflecting changes within 1 second for 95% of edits made.
- User satisfaction regarding the ease of formatting control should achieve a score of at least 4.5 out of 5 in feedback surveys after implementation.

Test Outline:
- Review the editing interface to confirm the availability of the specified formatting options.
- Test the real-time preview functionality by tracking the update speed during various edits.
- Conduct user feedback sessions to measure satisfaction levels with the formatting control features.

history.text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have robust control over the formatting and layout of articles so that they are visually appealing and enhance reader engagement.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editors must be able to customize at least 10 distinct formatting options, including font styles, colors, images, and layout structures.
- The system should allow real-time previews of changes, ensuring that modifications are visible within 2 seconds of being made.
- User engagement metrics, such as time on page and bounce rate, should improve by at least 15% within the first month after implementing enhanced formatting controls.

Test Outline:
- Verify that editors can access and utilize all specified formatting options in the article editing interface.
- Measure the time taken for real-time previews to update after changes are made.
- Analyze user engagement statistics before and after implementing the new formatting controls to assess the impact on reader behavior.

results.original_text: I want a search bar on the top of the page.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a website user, I want a search bar prominently positioned at the top of the page so that I can easily access it and find information quickly without navigating through multiple sections.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar must be visible on all pages and load within 1 second for 95% of users.
- Users should be able to initiate a search by typing at least 3 characters, with results displayed in under 2 seconds.
- The search bar must include an autocomplete feature that suggests at least 5 relevant queries based on user input.

Test Outline:
- Verify the visibility of the search bar on various pages to ensure it meets the design requirements.
- Measure the load time of the search bar and the response time for search results to confirm they adhere to the specified criteria.
- Test the autocomplete functionality by entering different queries to assess the relevance and speed of the suggestions provided.

history.text:
User Story:
As a user, I want a prominently placed search bar at the top of the page so that I can easily access the search feature and quickly find relevant content.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar must be visible and accessible on all pages, with at least 95% of users able to locate it within 5 seconds.
- The search bar should support autocomplete suggestions that display at least 3 relevant options based on user input.
- The search functionality must yield results that are relevant to the query, achieving at least a 90% accuracy rate.

Test Outline:
- Conduct usability testing to evaluate how quickly users can find the search bar on various pages.
- Analyze the effectiveness of autocomplete suggestions by measuring the average number of relevant options provided during searches.
- Review user feedback on the accuracy of search results to ensure the 90% relevance criterion is met.
